subject: Kickoff: factual-recall dissection as a debugging tool
body:
Daniela, team,

Kicking off the factual-recall track. The research gives us three instruments for looking inside an autoregressive model while it recalls a fact: attention knockout to trace information flow during inference, attribute extraction via projecting hidden states and sublayer outputs to the vocabulary (plus patching), and the subject-enrichment evaluation for measuring attribute rates. Together they answer 'where did this wrong fact come from' mechanistically rather than by vibes.

Product thesis: package these as a factuality-debugging workbench for the internal model teams, who currently debug hallucinations by staring at samples.

Milestones: reproduce the reference experiments on GPT2-xl by May 1, port the hook machinery to our internal 7B model by June 12, workbench pilot with one model team by July 3.

Priya
